paragraph.title: Protecting the Planet · Set 1
paragraph.description: Shadow a short connected passage about environment.

segments.text: Plastic has become so common that we barely notice it, yet the waste it creates is quietly overwhelming our oceans.
No single person can solve this problem alone, but millions of small efforts add up to enormous impact.
Renewable energy is no longer a distant promise but a rapidly growing part of how the world is powered.

paragraph.description: Shadow a short connected passage about environment.

segments.text: Much of this plastic is used for only minutes, but it can take centuries to break down completely.

Protecting nature is ultimately an act of respect for the generations who will inherit the earth from us.

paragraph.description: Shadow a short connected passage about education.

segments.text: The world is changing so quickly that the skills valued today may be outdated within a few short years.
Those who keep learning are the ones who adapt, while those who stop often find themselves left behind.
Interestingly, struggle is not a sign of failure but a crucial part of how the brain forms new connections.

Shops, restaurants, and public transport are everywhere, and there is always something to do.
A city reveals its true character not in its landmarks but in its ordinary neighbourhoods.

paragraph.title: City Life · Set 21
paragraph.description: Shadow a short connected passage about city.

segments.text: Yet city life brings its own challenges, from crowded streets to a strange loneliness among millions.
The mix of cultures in a great city can be one of its most beautiful features.
Even in the busiest place, a quiet morning street can feel surprisingly peaceful.

paragraph.title: Money & Habits · Set 1
paragraph.description: Shadow a short connected passage about money.

segments.text: When you track your spending, you often discover small leaks that quietly drain your budget.
Saving is not about denying yourself joy, but about giving your future self more freedom.
With a few steady habits, almost anyone can build a calmer relationship with money.

paragraph.title: Money & Habits · Set 2
paragraph.description: Shadow a short connected passage about money.

segments.text: Managing money well is less about how much you earn and more about the habits you build.
When you track your spending, you often discover small leaks that quietly drain your budget.
A little patience today can grow into real security over the coming years.

paragraph.title: Money & Habits · Set 3
paragraph.description: Shadow a short connected passage about money.

segments.text: A simple yet powerful habit is to spend less than you make and save the difference consistently.
It helps to wait a day before any large purchase, just to be sure you truly want it.
With a few steady habits, almost anyone can build a calmer relationship with money.

paragraph.title: The Digital World · Set 1
paragraph.description: Shadow a short connected passage about social media.

segments.text: It has reconnected old friends, raised money for good causes, and built communities around shared passions.
At the same time, it can amplify misinformation and quietly steal hours of our attention.
The endless comparison online can leave us feeling that our real lives are somehow not enough.

dialogue.title: At the Coffee Shop · Take 1
dialogue.description: Play a role in a daily life conversation and shadow each line.

segments.speaker: Barista
segments.text: Hi there! What can I get started for you today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, could I have a look at what you have first?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Do you have anything to eat with that?

segments.speaker: Barista
segments.text: Our blueberry muffins are fresh out of the oven.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: How much will that be altogether?

segments.speaker: Barista
segments.text: That comes to seven dollars and twenty cents.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Can I pay by card?

segments.speaker: Barista
segments.text: Absolutely, just tap whenever you are ready.

segments.speaker: Barista
segments.text: Your order will be ready in just a moment.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, thank you so much!

dialogue.title: A Job Interview · Take 1
dialogue.description: Play a role in a business conversation and shadow each line.

segments.speaker: Interviewer
segments.text: Thank you for coming in today. Please, take a seat.

segments.speaker: Candidate
segments.text: Thank you for having me, I am glad to be here.

segments.speaker: Interviewer
segments.text: Could you tell me a little about yourself?

segments.speaker: Candidate
segments.text: Of course. I have spent five years working in marketing.

segments.speaker: Interviewer
segments.text: Where do you see yourself in five years?

segments.speaker: Candidate
segments.text: Growing into a role where I can mentor a team of my own.

segments.speaker: Candidate
segments.text: May I ask what the team is like?

segments.speaker: Interviewer
segments.text: They are talented, friendly, and very collaborative.

segments.speaker: Interviewer
segments.text: Thank you. We will be in touch very soon.

segments.speaker: Candidate
segments.text: I appreciate your time, and I look forward to hearing from you.

dialogue.title: At the Train Station · Take 1
dialogue.description: Play a role in a travel conversation and shadow each line.

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.text: Hello, how can I help you?

segments.speaker: Passenger
segments.text: Hi, I would like a ticket to the city center, please.

segments.speaker: Passenger
segments.text: How much is that altogether?

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.text: That will be eight dollars.

segments.speaker: Passenger
segments.text: Do I need to change trains?

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.text: No, it goes there directly.

segments.speaker: Passenger
segments.text: Which platform did you say again?

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.text: Platform three, just down the stairs.

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.text: Here is your ticket. Have a safe trip.

segments.speaker: Passenger
segments.text: Thank you very much.

segments.text: What are your main fitness goals?

segments.text: I want to feel stronger and have more energy.

segments.text: Should I warm up before lifting?

segments.text: Always, a five-minute warm-up prevents injuries.

segments.speaker: Member
segments.text: How long should each session be?

segments.speaker: Trainer
segments.text: Let me write up a simple plan for you.

segments.speaker: Member
segments.text: That would be amazing, thank you!

segments.text: Thank you for calling Bella Pizza. How can I help you?

segments.text: Hi, I would like to order for delivery, please.

segments.text: Mushrooms and extra cheese, please.

segments.text: About thirty minutes from now.

segments.text: Your total is eighteen dollars. Thank you!

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect, thank you very much.

segments.speaker: Staff
segments.text: Thank you for calling Bella Pizza. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, I would like to order for delivery, please.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Mushrooms and extra cheese, please.

segments.speaker: Staff
segments.text: Great, anything to drink with that?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, one bottle of water.

segments.speaker: Staff
segments.text: Got it, would you like any sides?

segments.speaker: Staff
segments.text: Your total is eighteen dollars. Thank you!

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect, thank you very much.
